findings.title: Preserve legacy interaction for unsupported runs
findings.message: InteractionCells deliberately produces no cells for vertical and math runs, so their rune positions have no interaction carets. Replacing the previous RuneBounds lookup with a zero-vector fallback places the cursor at the field origin for these layouts. The new pointer and vertical-navigation paths also lack a legacy fallback, making unsupported layouts uneditable through those interactions.
findings.suggestion: Retain the previous RuneBounds-based charPos behavior when interaction geometry has no matching caret. Likewise, fall back to the previous RuneAtPoint and RuneAtLineDelta behavior when pointer or vertical navigation cannot resolve a supported caret. Add a vertical-text regression test.
